content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-p01-n2v3yc89/report.rdl

I changed `DateFrom` and `DateTo` from String to DateTime, so Report Builder and the report portal will now show date pickers for them instead of free-text boxes.

The file validates. The lint warnings (unused `LegacySQL` and `ScratchPowerQuery` data sources, and a `Utilization` field that the DAX doesn't return) were already there and I left them alone.

One thing to check: neither parameter is referenced in the dataset. `DataSet1`'s DAX has no `@DateFrom` or `@DateTo`, so the pickers won't filter the data yet. Wiring them in means adding a date filter to the `SUMMARIZECOLUMNS` query and a matching query parameter. I haven't done that because you asked only for the picker change. Tell me the filter you want (for example, `'Usage'[ReportDate]` between the two dates) and I'll add it.
